answer: The copper schedule is applied in inlet and forge reveals each instalment. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and therefore 30% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1602 identities would post 4093 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
